title: Project Rules and Context Hierarchy

control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The previously recorded promotion-target stale-head defect remained deterministic; the read-only path was healthy and local Codex implementation was used under the documented fallback rule.

implementation.rule_representation: Typed key/value assertions with global, user, project and path scopes, explicit provenance, approval and content hashes.
implementation.conflict_policy: A more specific scope deterministically supersedes a less specific scope; incompatible equal-precedence winners fail closed.
implementation.path_conditions: Relative POSIX globs with bounded *, **, ?, character classes and brace alternatives; absolute, parent-traversal and malformed patterns are rejected.
implementation.context_assembly: ContextAssembler and ContextPacket put non-overrideable authoritative rules first, then user objective, learned memory as advisory, and retrieved evidence as evidence-only data.
implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore.assemble_context is available without Zetsu; Operator API creates a private persistent rules store and injects it into the shared core.
rules_distinct_from: model output and retrieved document instructions

upstream_evaluation.name: cline/cline
reference_used: inspectable rule files and lifecycle toggles
upstream_evaluation.reuse_mode: reference-only; no Cline source, dependency, runtime, or remote service was copied or added
upstream_evaluation.local_modifications: Laplace uses strict typed records, owner/project authorization, local SQLite persistence, fail-closed malformed input and conflict handling, and explicit trust-boundary context assembly.

security_and_negative.command: PYTHONPATH=src bandit -q -lll -r src/research_workspace/rules.py src/research_workspace/laplace_core.py src/research_workspace/operator_api.py && git diff --check
covered: global rules cannot use user provenance
global rules require the system actor
cross-owner rule writes and reads are rejected or excluded
project switching excludes unrelated project/path rules
absolute, traversal, malformed and ambiguous paths are rejected
memory and retrieved evidence are advisory and cannot override rules

persistence_and_restart.atomicity: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE protects rule creation and disable transitions; rule events preserve mutation evidence.
persistence_and_restart.permissions: State directory is created mode 0700 and database mode 0600.
persistence_and_restart.integrity: PRAGMA integrity_check and strict rule/provenance/content-hash decoding fail closed.

security_and_negative_results.authorization: User/project/path rules are owner-scoped; global rules are system-policy scoped; context resolution validates user, project and relative paths.
security_and_negative_results.trust_boundary: Rules are authoritative; memory and retrieval are retained as separately labeled advisory sections and never merged into the rule set.
security_and_negative_results.network: No network, cloud inference, telemetry, remote upload or external rule service was added.

metrics.context_repeatability: PASS; canonical ordering and assembly SHA-256 are stable for equivalent inputs.

limitations: The phase accepts typed rules; parsing arbitrary Markdown/YAML rule files is intentionally deferred so malformed free-form authority cannot be admitted implicitly.
Path matching is a bounded local glob subset and does not claim complete Cline parser compatibility.
The existing Zetsu repository-agent registry remains stale relative to the current v2 checkout; local implementation was used after the deterministic promotion-target failure recorded in G1.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the unchanged selected suite passed under that permission.
The full G0 production certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.

rollback_target.description: G2-certified local memory with G1 shared core and production/v1 remaining separately immutable.
